info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Payment Order Cancellation-spec
info.description: The Payment Order Cancellation Management API allows users to effectively manage the cancellation of payment orders. This endpoint enables the deletion of specific cancellation records associated with payment orders, facilitating accurate bookkeeping and transaction integrity. Typically utilized by financial institutions and payment processors, this API supports compliance with operational protocols by ensuring that only valid cancellations are maintained. Leveraging this functionality, users can streamline their payment order lifecycle management and enhance overall efficiency.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel an existing payment order identified by its ID. Ensure that you have the necessary permissions to perform this action. Successful cancellation will remove the payment order from further processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a specific payment order identified by PAY-300045. It requires a properly formatted JSON body as defined in the schema.

202.description: The request has been accepted for processing; the cancellation is being processed.

DeletePaymentOrderCancellationRequest.description: This schema represents the body of a request to delete a cancellation operation for a specific payment order.
